text: Good morning Quillfeather! :coffee: Reminder that the coffee in the break room is free but the *motivation* is priceless. Have a great day. Or at least an okay one.

Everybody please give a big Wexley Falls welcome to @jordan, who is officially in *week 2* of their Quillfeather journey! :tada: Jordan, as I always say, there's no I in team, but there is one in Inside Sales. Coincidence? Yes.

There is no map. There is only me.
welcome to the paper trenches :saluting_face:
@jordan Fire exits are left of the copier and behind the water cooler. The one behind the water cooler is a closet but I've reported it.

text: @channel :trophy: The QUILLIES are BACK. Nominations are open for the 4th annual Quillfeather Excellence in Paper Awards. Categories include *Most Reams Moved*, *Best Customer Voice*, *Least Likely To Jam The Printer* and a mystery category I'm still workshopping. Ceremony is Friday when Denise from Regional visits. Nominate here: <https://quillfeather.example/quillies|quillies form>

unfurls.title: The Quillies 2026: nominations
unfurls.text: Nominate a coworker for the 4th annual Quillfeather Excellence in Paper Awards. Voting closes Thursday at 5pm.

text: Is "Most Reams Moved" decided by numbers or by vibes. Asking for a leaderboard.
Numbers AND vibes. The Quillies are a holistic experience :pray:

Friendly reminder that everyone needs to complete *Feelings & Forklifts: Module 3* by end of day Friday :slightly_smiling_face: It's about 40 minutes and there's a quiz at the end. The quiz is also friendly!
It is with a heavy heart that I announce the passing of Lamby, our laminator, at 9:36 this morning. Lamby died doing what Lamby loved: laminating something for Gordon.
reactions: rip-lamby marisol bev theo nadia kip ruth jordan wendell priya

replies.text: Those were the Quillies certificates :sob:
Lamby was purchased in 2019 for $84.99. I still have the receipt. I always have the receipt.
Before anyone asks: a laminator is not IT.
@theo it plugs into the wall
So does the microwave, Gordon.
I've cordoned off the area. Nobody touch it until it has cooled. Laminators can retain heat for up to forty minutes and that's just the ones I've timed.
lowkey we could laminate-as-a-service. people send us stuff, we laminate it. oh wait
Memorial service is at 3 by the copier. There will be no laminated programs, for obvious reasons.

text: Update: Quillies certificates will now be hand-lettered. By me. They will be very special.
Did anyone else see the vending machine flicker during Lamby's memorial. Just saying. Just putting it out there.
Nadia, we talked about this.
Big news team :rotating_light: Denise Calloway, our Regional VP, will be visiting the branch *this Friday*. Let's show her what Wexley Falls is made of! (Paper. We're made of paper.)

replies.text: What does she want
To see our culture! And possibly our numbers. Mostly culture. Please smile a normal amount.
Last time she visited she asked about the snack budget and I showed her a binder.
I'll do a full safety walkthrough Thursday. Every outlet. Every aisle. Every fire extinguisher's expiry date.
Tell her the warehouse is open for visits. Tell her upstairs keeps taking our pallets.
Wendell I'm going to tell her we are ONE FAMILY

text: I made a list for the supply closet restock. Add what you need. The good stapler is not on it and will not be on it.

replies.text: can i add a ring light
No.
Added sticky notes and a mouse pad. Is there a form for a chair that doesn't lean left?
@jordan Everyone's chair leans left. You'll lean right to compensate. Welcome to Quillfeather.

text: Hi all! :sparkles: Just a gentle nudge that only *4 of 11* of us have finished Feelings & Forklifts. I'm not going to say who. But Wendell knows.
I drive a forklift for a living, Ruth.
And now you'll drive it with *feelings* :heart:

Heads up, I've had four calls this morning from customers saying the online portal charges them a cent more than their quote on 10+ reams. ONE cent. On a $99 order. One of them called it "an insult in decimal form".

replies.text: Mine too. Harrow Dental ordered 12 reams and asked if we hate them.
The order portal isn't mine, that's the web vendor.
Theo, the web vendor contract ended in March. I have the termination letter.
…ok it's mine.
What about that Inkwell AI thing we got? The coding robot. @jordan you're young and good with computers, can you take a look?
Sure, happy to try! I'll ask Inkwell to dig into the discount rounding.
Please. I have Prinny to deal with.
Thank you Jordan! I'll tell callers we're on it. I will not tell them it's a robot.

text: Set up a channel for the portal fix: #inkwell-order-portal. Inkwell is reading the discount code now :eyes:
Reminder that the fridge is cleaned out Fridays at 4. Unlabeled items will be removed. Labeled items will ALSO be removed if the label is a threat.
the Quillies should be an NFT. hear me out
Kip I love the energy. No.
Expense reports for October are due tomorrow. If you bought something and want the money back, I need a receipt. A photo of the item is not a receipt. A story about the item is not a receipt.
Morning. Someone left the break room microwave running with nothing in it for 11 minutes. It is fine. It is very warm.
Feelings & Forklifts is due *Friday*! That's this Friday! :sparkles: 7 of 11 done, so proud of us.
Big shipment to Linfield Schools went out on time. Thanks warehouse. Don't let it go to your head.
Okay team, Denise update: she lands Friday at 10. I've ordered a cake. I've ordered a backup cake. Please do not eat the backup cake.
Two more portal discount calls this morning. Told them a fix is in progress and they said "by a human?" and I changed the subject.
